name: GO Classes CS/DA Test Series | Aptitude | Test 7

question.text:
Select the conclusion that best follows from the statement given below.

$\textbf{Statement:}$

Some mangoes are exported to Europe and most mangoes are consumed in India. In India, some mangoes are used for preparing mango juice and some are used for making jellies. All mangoes are consumed by humans unless they are raw mangoes. All raw mangoes are exported outside India.

$\textbf{Conclusions:}$

  1. All the mangoes exported to Europe are unfit for human consumption.
     
  2. Mango juice can also be prepared with raw mangoes.
     
  3. Most mangoes are consumed in India in the form of mango jelly.
     
  4. No raw mango was used to prepare jelly.

 

  1. Only conclusion I follows
     
  2. Only conclusion II follows
     
  3. Only conclusion III follows
     
  4. Only conclusion IV follows

If $\mathrm{P} @ \mathrm{Q}$ means $\text{P}$ is the brother of $\mathrm{Q}, \mathrm{P} \Delta \mathrm{Q}$ means $\text{P}$ is the mother of $\text{Q}$ and $\mathrm{P} \phi \mathrm{Q}$ means $\text{P}$ is the sister of $Q$, then which of the following would mean $\text{A}$ is the uncle of $\text{B}$?

  1. $\mathrm{A} \Delta \mathrm{P} @ \mathrm{B}$
     
  2. $\mathrm{A} \triangle \mathrm{B} @ \mathrm{P}$
     
  3. $\mathrm{A} @ \mathrm{P} \Delta \mathrm{B}$
     
  4. $\mathrm{A} \phi \mathrm{P} \Delta \mathrm{B}$

In a class, $25 \%$ of the students get a scholarship. There are $40$ girls and $50 \%$ of them get a scholarship. If the girls constitute $25 \%$ of the strength of the class, then find the percentage of boys who get a scholarship.

  1. $15 \%$
     
  2. $25 \%$
     
  3. $20 \%$
     
  4. None of these

Raghav buys a shop for  $120000$. He pays half of the amount in cash and agrees to pay the balance in $12$ annual installments of  $5000$ each. If the rate of interest is $12 \%$ and he pays with the installment the interest due on the unpaid amount, then find the total cost of the shop.

  1.  $168600$
     
  2.  $176800$
     
  3.  $176600$
     
  4.  $166800$

Many governments have passed laws requiring that bicyclists must wear helmets while riding. Most of these laws in the United States only apply to children; however, there are some jurisdictions, such as Australia, that have laws mandating helmet usage for adults as well. While these laws are intended to reduce the incidence of injuries, some bicycle safety advocates argue that they should be repealed because they can, in some circumstances, have the contrary effect.

Which of the following, if true, most helps to explain the position of the bicycle safety advocates?

  1. Classes that teach safe bicycling behaviors have been shown to be a more effective method of reducing injuries than are laws requiring helmets.
     
  2. A driver overtaking a cyclist who is not wearing a helmet is more likely to pass at a safe distance than if the cyclist were wearing a helmet.
     
  3. Bicycle helmet laws have been shown to discourage people from bicycling.
     
  4. Children are more vulnerable to head injuries while bicycling than are adults.

Study the given information carefully and answer the following question.

  • $'A \times B$' means '$A$ is the father of $B'$.
  • $'A+B^{\prime}$ means '$A$ is the brother of $B'$.
  • $'A-B^{\prime}$ means'$A$ is the brother-in-law of $B'$.
  • $'A * B$' means ' $A$ is the mother of $B'$.
  • $'A \# B'$ means ' $A$ is the son-in-law of $B'$.

Which of the following definitely means $K$ is the wife of $L$?

(i) $\mathrm{J} \times \mathrm{N}+\mathrm{L} \# \mathrm{M}^{*} \mathrm{~K}$

(ii) $\mathrm{N}+\mathrm{L}-\mathrm{M} \times \mathrm{K} \# \mathrm{~J}$

(iii) $J * L+N-K \times M$

  1. Only (i)
     
  2. Only (ii) and (iii)
     
  3. Only (i) and (ii)
     
  4. None of these

Ankita and Varun are $150$ m apart and facing towards each other. Ankita took a left turn and walked $30$ m , while Varun also took a left turn and walked $50$ m. Ankita then took two consecutive right turns walking $70$ m in each turn. Meanwhile Varun took a right turn and stopped after walking $40$ m . If Varun is now facing towards West direction, then how far and in which direction is Ankita now with respect to Varun?

  1. $10 \sqrt{17} \mathrm{~m}$, North-West
     
  2. $10 \sqrt{17} \mathrm{~m}$, North-East
     
  3. $10 \sqrt{17} \mathrm{~m}$, South-West
     
  4. $17 \sqrt{10} \mathrm{~m}$, North-West

For a set of $n$ integers in arithmetic progression, the difference between twice the median of the set and the range of the set is equal to twice the first term.

  1. Always
     
  2. Sometimes
     
  3. Never
     
  4. None of the above

Let $f(x)=x^{2}+b x+7$. If $f^{\prime}(5)=2 f^{\prime}\left(\frac{7}{2}\right)$, then the value of $b$ is

  1. $-4$
     
  2. $-7$
     
  3. $-2$
     
  4. $-1$

If the median of a set consisting of $n$ consecutive odd positive integers is an even integer, the sum of the mean and the range of the set is an odd integer.

  1. Always
     
  2. Sometimes
     
  3. Never
     
  4. None of the above
